design: Chronological OOF construction through 80%; 80-85 quantile/isotonic calibration; 85-90 conformal; 90-100 sealed audit. Calibration boundaries embargo h sessions from the preceding labelled block. Literal expanding-window replay refits experts at historical T0 using labels before T0-h only. Every sampled case retains data context available at origin, direct forecast, actual raw future price, corporate-action-adjusted realized return and expert predictions.

embargoAudit.policy: Each row is admitted only if its actual symbol-specific T+h label maturity date is strictly before the next lock boundary; sampled-origin ordinal distance is not used as a proxy for h trading sessions.

shrinkSelectionAudit.reason: gamma is a return-scale calibration parameter; identity is preferred when pre-blind MAE differences are statistically indistinguishable

distributionAudit.calibrationSplitPolicy: 80-85% exclusively fits tail-rank point shape/scale and quantile/isotonic calibration; early whole origin dates of maturity-purged 85-90% independently validate the locked point model; late origin dates of 85-90% are conformal-only; 90-100% remains sealed.
distributionAudit.expectedReturnDefinition: pre-blind selected monotone calibration of the direct return score
distributionAudit.priceConversion: raw close * exp(pre-blind calibrated expected log return)

familyFitAudit.regularisationInterpretation: larger tail power shrinks middle ranks more strongly toward zero; it is tail concentration, not extra model degrees of freedom
familyFitAudit.searchBoundaryRationale: p=3 was the prior upper boundary; extension to p=4,6 tests stronger middle-rank shrinkage while preserving the same one-dimensional monotone family

pointSelectionAudit.reason: power and scale were locked on 80-85% only and the unchanged candidate passed independent whole-date 85-90% moving-block MAE plus magnitude confirmation
pointSelectionAudit.tailPowerInterpretation: higher p is stronger shrinkage of middle ranks, while preserving monotone same-origin ordering
